       (p2:Player {name: "Roberto Gagliardini"})

  ELSE p2.name
END AS HeavierPlayer"

}

User question: What are the names and founding years of clubs that have been part of the Campeonato Brasileiro Série B and have used Melão as their home venue at some point?

Generate the Cypher query to answer the question.
response:
{
  "cypher": "MATCH (c:Club)-[:partOfLeague]->(l:League),
      (c)-[:hasHomeVenue]->(v:Venue)
WHERE l.name = "Campeonato Brasileiro Série B"

WITH lu, em,
     datetime(lu.date_of_death) AS luDeath,
     datetime(em.date_of_death) AS emDeath

         WHEN luDeath > emDeath THEN lu.name
         ELSE em.name

       toInteger(c1.inception_year) AS Year1,
       c2.name AS Club2,
       toInteger(c2.inception_year) AS Year2,
       CASE
         WHEN toInteger(c1.inception_year) > toInteger(c2.inception_year) THEN c1.name
         WHEN toInteger(c2.inception_year) > toInteger(c1.inception_year) THEN c2.name
         ELSE "Same year"
       END AS MoreRecentClub"
  ,
  "rationale": "The query explicitly matches the two clubs by name, retrieves their inception years as integers for comparison, and returns both clubs’ founding years along with the name of the club founded more recently."
}

WHERE FALSE
RETURN c.name AS clubName, 0 AS playerCount

Revise the previous query according to the feedback above.
response:
{
  "cypher": "MATCH (club:Club)-[*]->(p:Player)
MATCH (otherClub:Club {name:"S.S.D. Group Città di Castello"})-[*]->(p)
RETURN club.name AS clubName,
       count(DISTINCT p) AS playerCount
ORDER BY playerCount DESC"
  ,
  "rationale": "- Uses the existing `:Club` and `:Player` node labels from the schema.
- Varies the relationship type with `[*]` (any relationship, any direction) so the query can match players that have an association with both clubs even if the specific relationship type is not listed.
- Counts distinct players per club so each player is counted only once per club.
- Returns only clubs that have at least one such player, due to the join on the same `p` node.
- Orders the result by the player count so the most connected clubs appear first."
}
